contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #213: Critical percolation on every quasi-transitive graph.
Finite adaptive transcript entropy under a Bernoulli product reference and arbitrary dependent comparison law.

definitions.algorithm: Finite deterministic query tree; the next coordinate or stop depends only on its own answered prefix; no coordinate repeats along a path.
definitions.overlap: For every configuration in supp(Q), K_e is the number of algorithms whose unchanged individual paths read coordinate e.
definitions.reference: mu is Bernoulli(p) product on N bits, 0<p<1; Q is arbitrary; logarithms are natural.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 213 (Critical percolation on every quasi-transitive graph.; papers: Critical bond and site percolation on the cubic lattice; No percolation at criticality on quasi-transitive graphs; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/213.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Let G be an infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive undirected graph. If pc(G)<1, then P_pc(G)(there is an infinite open cluster)=0; equivalently P_pc(G)(|C_x|=infinity)=0 for every vertex x. Source: quasi-transitive manuscript thm:main.

For nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^3 there is almost surely no infinite open cluster at the bond critical parameter. The same holds for nearest-neighbor Bernoulli site percolation at the site critical parameter. Source: cubic manuscript build/introduction.tex thm:main.
Critical Bernoulli bond percolation has no infinite cluster on quasi-transitive graphs of exponential growth; external branch input thm:exponential, not verified here.
Subexponential upper growth and superpolynomial lower growth imply critical extinction; source thm:superpoly, relying on the two-cluster and interpolation estimates.
A polynomial lower-volume subsequence supplies the finite-index nilpotent quotient action used in prop:nilpotent-model; not verified here.
The nilpotent quotient action with finite orbit kernel and finite stabilizer images implies critical extinction; source thm:structured, not verified here.
For independent finite hyperedges, P(o connected to A and o connected to T) >= P(o connected to A) min_(a in A) P(a connected to T). Source: cubic manuscript intro:comparison; not verified here.
The cubic manuscript finite extension and relay geometry yield high-probability connections between neighboring coarse seed boxes; not verified here.

The cubic manuscript sequential coarse exploration and planar boundary count produce an infinite open cluster below criticality under the contradictory critical-survival hypothesis; not verified here.

On an infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph of subexponential growth, for every p_*>0 there is C such that P_p(H_s(e)) <= C s^(-1/2), uniformly over e,s>=1,p_*<=p<1. Source prop:two-cluster; not verified here.
For the specified finite lazy depth-first search, W=sum_(queried actual open pivots e) (1-p)d_e satisfies E_mu W<=1 and E_mu W^2<=3. Source lem:dfs; not verified here.
Under the hypotheses of prop:interpolation, some path edge e satisfies -log mu(H_s(e)) <= C(log(1/delta)+ceil(log_2 d)+1); the current mission verifies only its pair-transcript entropy dependency.
For arbitrary N,m, legal finite deterministic terminating no-reread algorithms, 0<p<1, and arbitrary Q, overlap K_e<=a only on supp(Q) implies sum_i D(Q_i||mu_i)<=a^2 D(Q||mu)/(2p(1-p)).

The cached uniform-permutation runner has predictable fresh nodes and Bernoulli(p) reference bits. Conditional on rank j and a fixed input with k readers, freshness has probability binom(m-1-j,k-1)/binom(m-1,k-1), preserving bit-reader dependence in pooled biases.

For integers 1<=a<=m, every real polynomial of degree <a satisfies z(0)^2 <= C(a,m) m^(-1) sum_(j=0..m-1) z(j)^2, where C(a,m)=sum_(k=0..a-1)(2k+1) product_(r=1..k)(m-r)/(m+r)<=a^2; this constant is exact.
Finite legal local and global transcript trees satisfy the relative entropy chain rule with fresh Bernoulli reference parameter p; d(r||p)<= (r-p)^2/(p(1-p)) and d(r||p)>=2(r-p)^2.

After the interpolation descriptor is fixed, each pair transcript is a deterministic terminating no-reread algorithm. On supp(Q_Omega), each original cluster occurs in at most two active-chain pairs and each edge meets at most two original clusters, hence each bit is read by at most four pair algorithms.
For the interpolation fixed-descriptor pair transcripts, sum_(i in I_*)D(Q_ti||mu_ti)<=8 D(Q_Omega||mu)/(p(1-p)), establishing eq:interpolation-pair-entropy without an overlap hypothesis under mu.

The upstream linked CriticalPercolation.lean and CriticalZ3.lean concluding proofs contain sorry and therefore do not themselves certify the mathematical criticality conclusions; this is not a refutation of those conclusions.

For arbitrary finite local-node and charged-global-node index sets, q_h>=0, C_h>0, nonnegative weights rho_hg, and arbitrary real reconstruction coefficients u_hg and biases beta_hg: if sum_g rho_hg u_hg beta_hg=q_h b_h and sum_g rho_hg u_hg^2<=C_h q_h, then sum_h q_h b_h^2/C_h<=sum_h sum_g rho_hg beta_hg^2. No independence of weights and biases is assumed.

Under the exact hypotheses of C_ENTROPY with m>=1 algorithms, sum_i D(Q_i||mu_i)<=C(min(a,m),m) D(Q||mu)/(2p(1-p)), where C(b,m)=sum_(k=0..b-1)(2k+1) product_(r=1..k)(m-r)/(m+r). More generally, sum_h Q(h)d(r_h||p)/C(a_h,m)<=D(Q||mu)/(2p(1-p)), with a_h the maximum reader count on the conditional support of local node h.

For arbitrary finite local-node and charged-global-node index sets, q_h>=0, C_h>0, nonnegative weights rho_hg, and arbitrary real reconstruction coefficients u_hg and biases beta_hg: if sum_g rho_hg u_hg beta_hg=q_h b_h and sum_g rho_hg u_hg^2<=C_h q_h, then sum_h q_h b_h^2/C_h<=sum_h sum_g rho_hg beta_hg^2. No independence of weights and biases is assumed.

import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace EntropySupport

theorem weighted_cauchy {G : Type*} [Fintype G]
    (w u v : G → ℝ) (hw : ∀ g, 0 ≤ w g) :
    (∑ g, w g * u g * v g) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ g, w g * u g ^ 2) * (∑ g, w g * v g ^ 2) := by
  exact Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul
    (r := fun g => w g * u g * v g)
    (f := fun g => w g * u g ^ 2)
    (g := fun g => w g * v g ^ 2)
    Finset.univ
    (fun g _ => mul_nonneg (hw g) (sq_nonneg _))
    (fun g _ => mul_nonneg (hw g) (sq_nonneg _))
    (fun g _ => le_of_eq (by ring))

theorem node_budget {G : Type*} [Fintype G]
    (w u v : G → ℝ) (q b C : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ g, 0 ≤ w g) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hreconstruct : ∑ g, w g * u g * v g = q * b)
    (hnorm : ∑ g, w g * u g ^ 2 ≤ C * q) :
    q * b ^ 2 / C ≤ ∑ g, w g * v g ^ 2 := by
  have henergy : 0 ≤ ∑ g, w g * v g ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun g _ => mul_nonneg (hw g) (sq_nonneg _))
  have hcs := weighted_cauchy w u v hw
  rw [hreconstruct] at hcs
  have hmul : (q * b) ^ 2 ≤ (C * q) * (∑ g, w g * v g ^ 2) :=
    hcs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnorm henergy)
  by_cases hzero : q = 0
  · simpa [hzero] using henergy
  · have hpositive : 0 < q := lt_of_le_of_ne hq (Ne.symm hzero)
    have hscaled :
        q * (q * b ^ 2) ≤ q * (C * (∑ g, w g * v g ^ 2)) := by
      nlinarith only [hmul]
    have hcancel := (mul_le_mul_left hpositive).mp hscaled
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hC).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hcancel

theorem budget_transfer {H G : Type*} [Fintype H] [Fintype G]
    (w u v : H → G → ℝ) (q b C : H → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ h g, 0 ≤ w h g) (hq : ∀ h, 0 ≤ q h)
    (hC : ∀ h, 0 < C h)
    (hreconstruct : ∀ h, ∑ g, w h g * u h g * v h g = q h * b h)
    (hnorm : ∀ h, ∑ g, w h g * u h g ^ 2 ≤ C h * q h) :
    (∑ h, q h * b h ^ 2 / C h) ≤
      ∑ h, ∑ g, w h g * v h g ^ 2 := by
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun h _ =>
    node_budget (w h) (u h) (v h) (q h) (b h) (C h)
      (hw h) (hq h) (hC h) (hreconstruct h) (hnorm h))

theorem entropy_budget_transfer {H G : Type*} [Fintype H] [Fintype G]
    (w u v : H → G → ℝ) (q b C cost : H → ℝ) (p D : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ h g, 0 ≤ w h g) (hq : ∀ h, 0 ≤ q h)
    (hC : ∀ h, 0 < C h) (hp : 0 < p) (hpone : p < 1)
    (hreconstruct : ∀ h, ∑ g, w h g * u h g * v h g = q h * b h)
    (hnorm : ∀ h, ∑ g, w h g * u h g ^ 2 ≤ C h * q h)
    (hcost : ∀ h, (p * (1 - p)) * cost h ≤ q h * b h ^ 2)
    (hbudget : (∑ h, ∑ g, w h g * v h g ^ 2) ≤ D / 2) :
    (∑ h, cost h / C h) ≤ D / (2 * (p * (1 - p))) := by
  have hpq : 0 < p * (1 - p) := mul_pos hp (sub_pos.mpr hpone)
  have hlocal :
      (∑ h, (p * (1 - p)) * (cost h / C h)) ≤
        ∑ h, q h * b h ^ 2 / C h := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro h _
    calc
      (p * (1 - p)) * (cost h / C h) =
          ((p * (1 - p)) * cost h) / C h := by ring
      _ ≤ q h * b h ^ 2 / C h :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hcost h) (hC h).le
  have hscaled : (p * (1 - p)) * (∑ h, cost h / C h) ≤ D / 2 := by
    calc
      (p * (1 - p)) * (∑ h, cost h / C h) =
          ∑ h, (p * (1 - p)) * (cost h / C h) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ h, q h * b h ^ 2 / C h := hlocal
      _ ≤ ∑ h, ∑ g, w h g * v h g ^ 2 :=
        budget_transfer w u v q b C hw hq hC hreconstruct hnorm
      _ ≤ D / 2 := hbudget
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hpq)).2
  nlinarith only [hscaled]

end EntropySupport

claims.natural_statement: For a finite undirected graph with independent edge probabilities in (0,1) and disjoint nonempty root sets A,B, conditional on A not connected to B, each exact cluster object is associated, and increasing functions of the two respective objects have nonpositive cross covariance. Source lem:avoidance; not independently verified in this mission.

For fixed exact incidence exposure of a union O of clusters and target anchors in O, the original-prefix DFS contact weight A=sum_f p d_f under the product exterior law has E A=h_*, E A^2<=3, and its normalized marked-contact exposure preserves the product law outside the enlarged exposure. Source interpolation contact-normalization and contact-second-moment; not verified here.

The interpolation fixed-descriptor marked density and injective active-contact opening/inverse procedure give D(Q_eta||mu)<=L+2 E_Q sum_(active i)log(1+S_i)+E_Q X. Source interpolation-density through interpolation-cost-to-bound; not verified by this entropy mission.

routes.retired_because: Fixed-set Shearer inequalities do not justify adaptive read paths or overlap controlled only on the support of Q; their hypotheses do not supply the required cached-history pooling.

The universal finite-permutation proof in research/entropy_support/report.md establishes the asserted entropy bound, including bit-dependent support-local reader counts. No counterexample was found or claimed; this mathematical proof and its statement fidelity await independent Reviewer scrutiny.

This decomposition captured C_ENTROPY_POOLING version 1 before its formal source was bound and corrected. The mathematical plan remains valid, but that version reference is stale; R_ENTROPY_FINITE_CURRENT records the identical obligations against the current certified claim version.
